verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm the core mechanism: agents load only skill name+description at startup 'just enough to know when it might be relevant,' which is the basis for automatic contextual triggering (skills-cli-docs-3/12), and the SKILL.md spec defines the frontmatter (name/description) that drives this (skills-cli-docs-16). However there's no guidance on engineering effective descriptions, no hands-on evidence of trigger accuracy, and community discussion focuses on leaderboard fairness and missing package-management docs rather than validating activation behavior. Missing for 10: best-practice guidance for writing trigger-accurate descriptions, independent/hands-on evidence that the right skill actually activates at the right moment, and any discussion of false-positive/false-negative activation.
